_steel: The four steel marbles rendered as four identical dark grey spheres on the contact sheet, which is the exact fault that sheet exists to catch. Steel has almost no saturation, so a hue chosen from the name does nothing for it; they are separated by hand here instead.

rusty._recipe: DESIGN 10.3 calls it pitted, so it is slag over a rust palette rather than clean steel.

_grails: Until Stephen's Meshy figures land, the four grails carry the custom interior rather than plain glass. On the sheet they were the four least interesting marbles in the game, which is backwards for the rarest things in it.

nine_vane._vanes: DESIGN 10.3 names it a nine vane cat's eye, so it has nine.

_abilities: Ability text on the inspect card. DESIGN 10's cells are designer shorthand (dmg, arrows, notes to self) and the card printed them as they stand. These say the same mechanic in the player's words, no dashes, every number kept; the generator keeps the doc's cell beside them as `spec` so a doc change shows in the diff.
